content.text: Good! The Programmer Agent successfully handled a moderate complexity task. Let me try a slightly more complex one to approach its token limit:

input.task: Create a Python web application using Flask that implements: (1) User authentication with sessions, (2) A REST API with CRUD operations for managing tasks, (3) Database integration using SQLAlchemy with at least 3 related tables, (4) Input validation and error handling, (5) Basic security measures (CSRF, password hashing), (6) A simple HTML interface with forms, and (7) Unit tests for the core functionality. Include configuration management and deployment instructions.
